summary: A sponsored 9to5Google post promoting Rowan, Rocket Money's AI financial assistant that works over text messages. It watches connected accounts, sends proactive alerts and weekly summaries, and can start subscription cancellations and bill negotiations that Rocket Money staff finish behind the scenes. The piece is promotional, with no independent testing or user evidence.
speakers_or_authors: 9to5Google (sponsored content on behalf of Rocket Money; no named author)
relevance_reason: It touches on personal context (connected financial accounts) and an agent-like assistant in a messaging interface. It is a sponsored product pitch with no hands-on evidence, and the 'agent' actions are workflows handed to human-run back-end operations, so it is a passing mention for the brief's themes.

claims.claim: Rowan is connected directly to the user's finances and built to take action, unlike general chatbots that can only talk about money.
claims.quote: Most AI assistants can only talk about your money, whereas Rowan is directly connected to your finances and built to take action.

claims.claim: Rowan runs on Rocket Money's existing platform and taps its established cancellation and negotiation operations.
claims.quote: it taps directly into the established subscription cancelation and bill negotiation operations that Rocket Money has been running for years.

claims.claim: Rowan lives only in text messages, with no new app or interface to learn, and complements the main Rocket Money app.
claims.quote: Because Rowan lives entirely in your text messages, there is no new app to download and no complicated interface to learn.

claims.claim: Rowan proactively texts users about low balances, new subscriptions and price increases, and sends weekly spending summaries.
